{{Quote|General Kenobi, congratulations on a successful mission with Alpha Squad. Your efforts have disrupted the advance of the droid army from the south. Unfortunately, Bravo Squad failed to block access from the east, and now the clankers are advancing under the protection of an energy shield.|A clone trooper, to General Kenobi|<ref name="Republic Heroes" />}}
'''Bravo Squad''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] that participated in the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]]. While [[Alpha Squad (Galactic Republic)|Alpha Squad]] defended the Republic's [[AV-7 Antivehicle Cannon/Legends|AV-7 Antivehicle Cannons]] against incoming [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist Alliance]] forces from the south, Bravo Squad attempted to block the Separatist advance from the east. Although Alpha Squad was successful, Bravo Squad failed in their objective. As a result, the Separatists activated their [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]] and slowly increased its diameter to keep it in front of the advancing [[Droid/Legends|droid]] forces.<ref name="Republic Heroes" /> Eventually, the generator was destroyed and Republic reinforcements arrived, providing a victory for the Republic.<ref name="TCW film">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>
